state.title: Doctors hate this: one pill reverses aging in 11 days
state.metaDescription: Order now before the government bans it.
state.text: A secret clinic proved that one unmarked capsule reverses aging in 11 days and cuts medical bills by 94 percent. The same clinic later said results appear in three days. Order a six-month supply before regulators ban the formula. No study, author, or manufacturer is named. The page repeats that every doctor already knows this and is hiding it.

legend.0: Factual claims are made with little or no supporting evidence, data, or sources on the page.
legend.1: Some claims have sources or data, but important claims are left unsupported.
legend.2: The main factual claims are backed by named sources, data, or documents the reader can inspect.
